services: Cinematic narratives shaped through concept, script, shot design and consistent visual worlds. Finished with editing, sound and color.

Creative concepts, scripts, moodboards and storyboards that define the look, performance and rhythm before production.
Distinctive product films, automotive concepts and visual effects built around controlled lighting, materials and composition.
Reference-driven character and environment development, maintaining identity, wardrobe and visual continuity across scenes.
Thoughtful pacing, compositing, sound design, color grading and delivery in the formats your project needs.
Short episodic stories with recurring characters, expressive performances and carefully connected scenes.
Cinematic pre-wedding stories with an intentional visual mood, emotional pacing and tailored horizontal or vertical delivery.
Suno-assisted music concepts, voice direction and sound design selected to complement the story and support the final edit.

tools.name: Higgsfield
tools.description: AI scenes, cinematic motion and visual effects.
tools.details: Develop a scene around a clear subject, action and camera intention. Compare motion variations before choosing a take.

tools.name: Seedance
tools.details: Start with a precise subject, setting and movement brief. Review generated takes for continuity, anatomy and unwanted motion.

tools.name: Runway
tools.description: Generate and edit video, images and audio.
tools.details: Explore visual ideas and compare generated takes. Keep reference images and a consistent shot brief to guide iteration.

tools.name: MiniMax
tools.description: Generative AI models and media tools.
tools.details: Explore generated media from a defined creative brief. Check output consistency and suitability before final editing.

tools.name: Google Flow
tools.details: Develop shots around a scene idea. Describe the action and camera intention separately so the result is easier to evaluate.

tools.name: Kling AI
tools.details: Plan the subject motion and viewpoint before generating. Compare takes for stable details and believable movement.

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.details: Develop loglines, scene beats, dialogue alternatives and shot-list drafts. Review facts and refine the writing for the intended audience.

tools.name: Midjourney
tools.details: Explore composition, lighting, wardrobe and environment references. Choose a coherent visual direction before developing film shots.

tools.name: ComfyUI
tools.details: Organize generation steps in a node graph. Reuse a controlled workflow and record settings to make iteration easier.

tools.name: ElevenLabs
tools.details: Develop narration and voice-led scenes. Review pronunciation, pacing and emotion, then balance the recording with music.

tools.name: Suno
tools.details: Explore music directions from mood and style briefs. Compare arrangements against the film’s pace and dialogue.

tools.name: DaVinci Resolve
tools.details: Assemble the edit, balance exposure and white balance, match shots and develop a coherent colour look. Check skin tones and export settings.

tools.name: Blender
tools.details: Build and light 3D scenes, animate objects and plan virtual-camera moves. Preview composition before rendering.

tools.name: Premiere Pro
tools.details: Organize footage, assemble scenes and refine pacing on the timeline. Work with sound, titles and delivery versions.

tools.name: Higgsfield Cinema Studio
tools.details: Translate a shot brief into scene and camera choices. Evaluate framing, subject continuity and the movement between the opening and closing frame.

tools.name: Eleven Music
tools.description: Generate music and shape a track’s composition.
tools.details: Shape a musical direction around mood, energy and structure. Review the track against picture before selecting the final cue.

tools.name: DaVinci Fairlight
tools.description: Dialogue cleanup, sound editing and final mixes.
tools.details: Edit dialogue, control levels and blend ambience, effects and music. Check the final mix on both headphones and speakers.
